title: Search: tell the client whether there are more pages
description: The new infinite-scroll list on mobile has to work out from page/last_page whether to load more, and gets it wrong on empty results. The search meta now includes `has_more`. Existing pagination test extended.

defects.explanation: `currentPage() <= lastPage()` is true on the last page too (and on an empty result, where both are 1), so has_more is always true and the client keeps requesting; it should be `<` (or hasMorePages()).
